messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "refills and quantity limits vary by state"
set: ["refills and quantity limits vary by state", "pharmacy laws may vary by state", "specifically approved by FDA", "cleared by the kidneys", "not broken down by the body", "time for blood levels to fall by half", "appearance and imprints", "4,500 children and teenagers", "discontinued and no longer available", "pooled analysis of 53 mother and infant pairs", "daily doses higher than 240 mg administered in equally divided doses by 15-minute infusion have not been studied", "4 NovoFine Plus needles with 1 mg and 2 mg pens", "13,299 adults with type 2 diabetes and established cardiovascular disease", "inconsistent reports on growth restriction, early birth, and death around birth", "sudden, unexpected attacks of extreme fear and worry about these attacks", "collects information about health of females exposed to Adderall and their babies"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
